Promotional_pricing is explicitly disfavored: memory_73 shows it bought a short-term 31% trial and 18% revenue lift while renewal churn rose 12 points, which is value-destroying against a sustainable long-term qualified revenue objective — and the note that 'reporting cadence was the standard one' suggests the churn damage may have been measured too early and could be understated, not overstated.
